Bagelsmith Restaurant & Deli

Bagelsmith Restaurant & Deli

Bagelsmith Restaurant & Deli is a bagel shop and breakfast and lunch restaurant in Easton, PA. Its own description promises 'a variety of flavored bagels delivered fresh daily' and 'a full breakfast and lunch menu.'

Dine-in or take-out, with one house rule stated up front: 'Kitchen closes 30 mins. prior to closing!'
